content: PRIMARY-VERIFIED (huggingface.co model card + config files): microsoft/harrier-oss-v1-0.6b MIT, 0.6B params, 1024 dims, 32768 ctx, Qwen3Model (config transformers_version 4.57.6), last-token pooling + L2 norm, MTEB Multilingual v2 69.0, 94 languages. config_sentence_transformers.json: prompts web_search_query/sts_query/bitext_query, default_prompt_name null, cosine. Query side MUST use prompt_name='web_search_query'; docs NO prompt; do NOT set default_prompt_name (would hit doc side). GGUF: majentik/harrier-oss-v1-0.6b-GGUF-Q8_0 (Q8_0 only, 639MB, MIT, community, ~47 downloads/mo, no llama-cpp guidance) — use Llama(embedding=True, pooling_type=LLAMA_POOLING_TYPE_LAST=3) + manual query instruction prefix. Same 1024 dims as Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B -> embedder identity marker required (locked decision).
